questions.stem: In strict total intravenous anaesthesia, what agents are used for induction and maintenance?
questions.answer: IV agents, with an oxygen/air mix

questions.answer: No point-of-delivery measurement equivalent to end-tidal agent monitoring

questions.stem: Why is propofol TIVA a concern in long cases or obese patients?
questions.answer: Propofol context-sensitive half-life becomes long

questions.stem: Why may propofol TIVA be contraindicated in hepatic surgery?
options: Propofol is cleared by the liver
Propofol is cleared by the kidneys
Propofol is cleared by the lungs
Propofol is broken down by plasma cholinesterase

questions.stem: In children, which metabolic disorders raise the risk of propofol infusion syndrome with TIVA?
questions.answer: Mitochondrial disease, fatty acid oxidation disorders, coenzyme Q deficiency

questions.stem: Which two pump types can deliver propofol for TIVA?
questions.answer: TCI syringe pump or ordinary syringe pump

questions.stem: In TIVA, what can a pharmacokinetic pump target?
questions.answer: Plasma (Cp) or brain/effect site (Ce)

questions.stem: How should the propofol target be adjusted during TIVA?
questions.answer: Titrate it to clinical signs and BIS

questions.answer: Patient characteristics, co-administered drugs and situation

questions.stem: Per AAGBI, how should TIVA targets start in older, frail or unwell patients?
options: A high initial target with one large bolus
A target set only after waking
A low initial target with repeated small increments
A fixed maximum target from the start

questions.stem: In TIVA, what does the FRCA suggest noting to gauge a patient's sensitivity?
questions.answer: Estimated Ce at loss of consciousness and at airway manipulation

questions.stem: Why must the remifentanil dose be factored into the propofol target in TIVA?
questions.answer: Propofol with remifentanil is synergistic

questions.stem: Compared with premedicated patients, what target do unpremedicated patients need in TIVA?

questions.answer: While dressings go on

questions.stem: What propofol waking concentration is quoted for TIVA?
When deepening TIVA quickly, why is a high initial target set?
questions.answer: So the bolus runs at maximum rate

questions.stem: If a TIVA pump fails and volatiles are not contraindicated, what is the safest first option?
options: Restart the pump in TCI mode
Wait for the pump to be repaired

questions.stem: After a propofol pump fails, what manual rate is usually needed at steady state?

options: The pump cannot run a pharmacokinetic model
The pump cannot deliver a bolus
The pump needs a fixed weight-based dose
The pump does not know about drug already at the effect site

questions.stem: In elderly, ASA 3-5 or haemodynamically compromised patients, how should TIVA targets be raised?
options: In small steps to avoid instability
In one large step for speed

questions.stem: For TIVA, which patients does the Schnider model accept?
How should TIVA be titrated in obese patients?
questions.answer: To clinical effect with pEEG monitoring

questions.stem: Per AAGBI, how should propofol be delivered for maintenance to help prevent awareness?
In TIVA, when does AAGBI advise using processed EEG such as BIS?
questions.answer: When a neuromuscular blocker is used

questions.stem: What is the aim of combined intravenous volatile anaesthesia (CIVA)?
questions.answer: Combine the benefits of TIVA and volatile anaesthesia

questions.stem: In CIVA, what volatile dose (in MAC) may lower awareness risk?
In CIVA, what does adding 0.5 MAC volatile allow?
questions.answer: A smaller propofol dose

questions.stem: In CIVA, what benefit does a smaller propofol dose give?
questions.answer: Faster waking and earlier neurological examination

questions.stem: In CIVA, which two elimination routes may speed emergence?
questions.answer: Lungs and liver

questions.stem: What is the main problem with combined intravenous volatile anaesthesia?
questions.answer: Harder to judge depth

questions.stem: In NAP5, what technique were awareness reports with TIVA often linked to?
Why do some swap between TIVA and volatile in long cases?
questions.answer: To limit build-up of either and speed emergence

questions.stem: In the Bristol 10-8-6 manual TIVA model, what blood propofol level is aimed for within 2 minutes?

questions.answer: 6 mg/kg/h

questions.stem: In the Bristol 10-8-6 derivation, what else did patients receive besides propofol?
questions.answer: Nitrous oxide, and were ventilated

questions.stem: In the Bristol scheme, what if a higher level of anaesthesia is needed?
questions.answer: Adjust the scheme or add a supplement such as remifentanil infusion

questions.stem: Compared with manual infusion, how much propofol does TCI use overall?

questions.answer: Better haemodynamic stability and faster waking

questions.stem: What kind of model does a TCI microprocessor pump run?

questions.answer: Elimination

questions.stem: In a TCI pump, what do the two falling infusions match?

questions.stem: Are the displayed levels on a TCI pump measured or calculated?
options: Measured by a sensor in the pump

What bolus rate does a TCI pump use to fill the central compartment at induction?

questions.answer: A much lower variable rate matching exponential transfer and uptake

questions.stem: What does a TCI pump do when the target is raised?
options: Pauses the infusion until the level falls

questions.stem: What does a TCI pump do when the target is lowered?
options: Pauses the infusion until the level falls

questions.stem: On TCI pumps showing decrement time, what default plasma level is used?

questions.answer: Other hypnotics (especially opioids) or liver impairment

questions.answer: Separate from the three compartments

questions.answer: Equilibrate plasma and effect site as fast as possible

questions.stem: Which adult propofol TCI model dates from 1991?

questions.answer: Large predicted V1

questions.stem: In adult propofol TCI, what time to peak effect is quoted for plasma targeting?

questions.answer: Lag before Ce equilibrates

questions.stem: In adult propofol TCI, what does the modified Marsh model target?
questions.answer: The effect site

questions.stem: What is the upper body weight limit for the adult propofol TCI models?
